title: 事故预防十二问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/25_Safety Quiz Accident Prevention Safety Quiz MCQ Test Accident Prevention HSE STU.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/25_Safety Quiz Accident Prevention Safety Quiz MCQ Test Accident Prevention HSE STU/src.py

points.K13: 发现电气隐患立即报告
points.S3: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼门口举着问答牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory building entrance holding a blank quiz card and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 新学期第一课：事故预防十二问！

shots.scene: 一排图标：盾牌、电话、脚印、手套、闪电
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a phone, a footprint, a glove and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 报告、培训、防滑倒、防护、用电。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进实验室，东张西望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a laboratory for the first time, looking around curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进实验室，什么都新鲜。

shots.scene: 阿杰差点被地上的纸箱绊倒，小研扶住他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nearly trips over a cardboard box on the floor; the female graduate student catches his arm.
shots.narration: 差点被地上的纸箱绊一跤。

shots.scene: 小研笑着递给他一张空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and hands him a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 小研说：先做十二道题，再进门干活。

shots.scene: 答题卡上十二个空格
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card with twelve empty boxes in two columns. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十二题，每题先自己选。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot ticks a box on a whiteboard with a marker.
shots.narration: 每题之后公布答案，再讲原因。

shots.scene: 盾牌和一个钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon beside a money bag icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：事故是什么样的？

shots.scene: “生活的一部分”图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shrugging person is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 能预防，代价高，不是倒霉难免。

shots.scene: 医药箱、坏仪器、停工牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a first aid box, a broken instrument and a closed sign on a door. No people.
shots.narration: 受伤、损坏、停课，代价都很大。

shots.scene: 阿杰手指划破，捂着手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his finger after a small cut at the bench.
shots.narration: 第二题：自己受伤了怎么办？

shots.scene: 阿杰去找老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student goes straight to the older man and shows his finger.
shots.narration: 马上告诉导师或实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 继续干活和日历拖延图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person working on with a bandage and a calendar with a week circled. No people.
shots.narration: 不硬撑，不拖一周再说。

shots.scene: 电话图标显示 120，旁边是学院和保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone icon beside a college building icon and a security shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 伤重拨120，按学校程序逐级报告。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：云、人、机器、路标
shots.prompt_en: Four icon cards: a rain cloud, a person, a machine and a road sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：多数事故因为什么？

shots.scene: 人那张卡被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The card with the person icon is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是人：不安全的行为最常见。

shots.scene: 王老师指着管理和设备两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at two icons: a rules clipboard and a gear.
shots.narration: 也要从管理和设备上找原因。

shots.scene: 阿杰面前一台没学过的仪器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of an unfamiliar instrument, hand hovering over it.
shots.narration: 第四题：我怎么帮助预防事故？

shots.scene: 阿杰缩回手，拿起培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his hand back and looks at a blank training certificate.
shots.narration: 只做自己受过培训的工作。

shots.scene: 替别人操作的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one person taking over another person's task is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别人的活，没学过别乱接手。

shots.scene: 地上的纸箱、电线和水渍
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory floor with a cardboard box, a loose cable and a small puddle of water. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：滑倒绊倒多因为什么？

shots.scene: 一个人边看手机边走路的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person looking at a phone while walking is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 地上乱放东西，走路不看前方。

shots.scene: 小研把纸箱搬走，擦干水渍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the box aside and wipes up the puddle.
shots.narration: 随手清理，走路看路。

shots.scene: 老李拿着电钻，胸前别着授权卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a power drill and wears a blank authorization badge.
shots.narration: 第六题：用工具的人必须怎样？

shots.scene: “很小心”图标旁有问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a careful face with a question mark beside it, next to a training certificate with a check. No people.
shots.narration: 光小心不够，要培训并获得授权。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头看着实验步骤
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head while looking at a blank procedure sheet.
shots.narration: 第七题：拿不准怎么做呢？

shots.scene: 阿杰去问老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man, who explains with a gesture.
shots.narration: 先问导师或负责人。

shots.scene: 瞎试和放慢速度的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: random trial arrows and a snail. No people.
shots.narration: 不自己乱试，也不是慢慢做就行。

shots.scene: 阿杰打着哈欠走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns widely as he walks into the laboratory, eyes half closed.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪种情况容易出事？

shots.scene: 床和月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: A bed icon with a crescent moon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 前一晚没睡好，注意力会下降。

shots.scene: 小研让阿杰先休息，改天再做危险步骤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points the young male student to a chair to rest.
shots.narration: 太累就说出来，危险步骤改时间。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、防护鞋摆在台上
shots.prompt_en: Safety goggles, gloves and closed safety shoes laid out on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：个人防护用品是什么？

shots.scene: 想戴就戴、嫌不舒服的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person tossing goggles aside and a frowning face. No people.
shots.narration: 某些工作的硬要求，不是想戴才戴。

shots.scene: 小研给阿杰调整护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student adjust his safety goggles.
shots.narration: 学校按要求配，自己按要求戴。

shots.scene: 墙上四类标志：禁止、警告、指令、提示
shots.prompt_en: A wall with four safety signs in a row: a no smoking sign, a flammable warning sign, an eye protection sign and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：安全标志告诉你什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指着标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the safety signs one by one.
shots.narration: 危险在哪、要当心什么、该怎么做。

shots.scene: 四个标志被大括号圈起
shots.prompt_en: The four signs are grouped by a big green bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都是。

shots.scene: 阿杰看到隔壁同学摔倒在地
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees another student who has slipped and fallen on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 第十一题：看到别人出事怎么办？

shots.scene: 不管不问、只是叹气的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person walking away and a sighing face. No people.
shots.narration: 不能不管，光同情也没用。

shots.scene: 阿杰扶住同学并给老周打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks on the fallen student and calls the older man on his phone.
shots.narration: 确认安全，立即报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 插线板冒火花，电线外皮破损
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a frayed cable and a small spark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：发现电气隐患呢？
overlay: 发现电气隐患立即报告

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 阿杰拔掉插头，贴上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the wall socket and attaches a blank out-of-service tag to the power strip.
shots.narration: 停止使用，立即报告。

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 自己拆修的图标打叉，老李拿着工具赶来
shots.prompt_en: A screwdriver-in-socket icon is crossed out with a red X as the facility engineer arrives with a toolbox.
shots.narration: 不自己修，等专业人员处理。

shots.scene: 实验室过道上横着一根电源线
shots.prompt_en: A power cable runs across a laboratory aisle on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆横穿过道，很容易绊人。

shots.scene: 老李用线槽把电线沿墙固定
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fixes the cable along the wall in a cable cover.
shots.narration: 沿墙走线，或用线槽盖好。

shots.scene: 过道畅通，纸箱放进储物架
shots.prompt_en: A clear laboratory aisle; boxes are stored neatly on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 过道和出口，时刻保持畅通。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着短裤拖鞋站在门口，被小研拦下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in shorts and sandals is stopped at the lab door by the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 短裤拖鞋，不能进实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上实验服、长裤和包脚鞋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student now wears a lab coat, long trousers and closed shoes.
shots.narration: 实验服、长裤、不露脚的鞋。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back her long hair.
shots.narration: 长发扎起，按本实验室要求穿戴。

shots.section_title: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 小研低头弯腰看显微镜，脖子前伸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hunches over a microscope with her neck stretched forward.
shots.narration: 长时间看显微镜，脖子肩膀最累。
overlay: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损

shots.section_title: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 小研调高座椅，挺直坐好，目镜贴近眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair height and sits upright, the eyepieces at eye level.
shots.narration: 调好椅子和目镜，坐直别探头。

shots.section_title: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 小研抬头看远处，转动肩颈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks away into the distance and gently rolls her shoulders.
shots.narration: 隔一会儿抬头远看，活动肩颈。

shots.section_title: 显微镜观察防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 欣欣摸着脖子，旁边是医院图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot touches its neck with a concerned look, a small clinic icon beside it.
shots.narration: 酸痛麻木持续，要及时就医。

shots.scene: 一排图标：盾牌、电话、证书、问号、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a phone, a certificate, a question mark and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 能预防、快报告、学过再做、不懂就问。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，过道干净
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, dressed properly with goggles, walks down a clear laboratory aisle.
shots.narration: 休息好、穿戴好、过道清清爽爽。

shots.scene: 阿杰把答题卡交给小研，满分
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a completed answer card to the female graduate student, who gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 十二题全对，阿杰可以进门了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 事故能预防，从每个小习惯开始！
